period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported, Solo/Standalone -- 'BALANCE SHEET' heading without the 'CONSOLIDATED' prefix used elsewhere in the same filing, per project convention of preferring Solo over Consolidated). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2017 (as published in UCB's own standalone unaudited interim financial statements filed on ucb.com.bd's investor-relations Financial Statements archive -- a different, richer source than the FY2013-2016 annual-report-embedded audit-committee table used elsewhere in this dataset) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as FY2013-2016. Most of this era's UCB interim-statement PDFs (2017 through 2023, plus 2025 Q1/Q2) are pure image scans with no embedded text layer, requiring tesseract 5.5.3 OCR (150dpi full-document pass to locate the Solo Balance Sheet/P&L/Notes pages, keyed off page headings, since page layout/count varies by year); the 2024 and 2025 Q3 filings do have an embedded text layer but it uses a corrupted font character-to-glyph mapping that pdftotext cannot read for numeric cells, so those were instead re-rendered at 300dpi and OCR'd the same way. All PDFs were downloaded directly from ucb.com.bd and deleted immediately after extraction per project policy. eps_cumulative (2.26), nav_per_share (25.08) and nocfps_cumulative (12.21) were illegible/garbled in this report's own scan and are instead taken from the FY2018 Q3 report's clean comparative ('30-Sep-17') column; net_profit_after_tax_cumulative (2,387,485,100) matches the FY2016 Q3 file's own recorded comparator chain and is corroborated by the FY2018 Q3 report's comparative column exactly.
